purpose: Define buttons, toggles, sliders and other operational controls as explicit invocation surfaces bound to canonical operations rather than direct arbitrary client-side effects.

topics.name: Operational Control Element
topics.purpose: Define buttons, toggles, sliders and other operational controls as explicit invocation surfaces bound to canonical operations rather than direct arbitrary client-side effects.

semantics.operation_rule: Every effectful control resolves an exact canonical operation identity.
semantics.argument_rule: Control state/value maps to explicit validated operation arguments.
semantics.display_state_rule: Displayed enabled/disabled/active state is a projection and not an authorization decision.
semantics.optimistic_rule: Optimistic UI state, if used, remains provisional until authoritative result.
semantics.failure_rule: Denied/failed operation restores or marks provisional UI state explicitly.
semantics.authority_rule: Rendering or interacting with a control never bypasses AccessCore.

invariants.rule: Expose Elements are reusable human-interface primitives that project or invoke explicitly bound semantics; visual form, nesting, focus, color, position or enabled-looking state never creates ownership, authority or domain meaning.

hard_gates.condition: button executes hidden arbitrary JS as canonical effect
optimistic state shown permanently after failed operation
control target inferred from DOM proximity

references.purpose: Operational controls invoke normal runtime dispatch.

prose.summary: Define buttons, toggles, sliders and other operational controls as explicit invocation surfaces bound to canonical operations rather than direct arbitrary client-side effects.
